case_number: 2024 INSC 779; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. of 2024 (ARISING OUT OF THE SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRIMINAL) NO.251 OF 2020)
summary: Appeal against death penalty for murder of pregnant daughter; motive questioned (inter-caste marriage revenge delayed by one year); reliability of PW2 (driver with prior monetary dispute) disputed; non-examination of material witnesses (teashop owner, bystanders, PW2's wife) contested; contradictory testimony between PW1 and PW3; forensic gaps (unverified ligature string, unexplained facial injuries); High Court confirmation of trial court's conviction under IPC 302 (murder), 316 (causing death of quick unborn child), 364 (kidnapping) challenged; mitigating circumstances claimed.
final_judgment: Appeal outcome unspecified in excerpt; arguments presented for acquittal or commutation to life imprisonment based on evidentiary gaps and procedural defects.
